'''Geoff Gallo-Cornell That Thing Is Operational V2 5''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Geoff Gallo-Cornell]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-8954">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8954 That Thing Is Operational V2 5], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 31 July 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/8954/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/8954/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018143317/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8954/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Geoff Gallo-Cornell]]
* '''Published:''' 31 July 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''That Thing Is Operational V2 5''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor (Dark)|Endor-D-endor.gif|label=Endor}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Operational As Planned|DS2-D-operationalasplanned.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Desperate Counter|DS2-D-desperatecounter.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 ED Gallo-Cornell DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is my second posted version of my other deck. I made some revisions, and made it stronger for ground attacks.

== Original post ==

'''That Thing Is Operational V2 5'''
* '''Author:''' Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell
* '''Published:''' July 31, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is my second posted version of my other deck. I made some revisions, and made it stronger for ground attacks.

=== Strategy ===

same basic idea as the first one. just get the epic event down asap. then move to kashyyyk, and get your guys down, pretty self-explanatory. Use the flawless marksmanships with the movement phase shots the scythes have to eliminate ships doing an attack run. that is about it.
